scope: NVE derived and algebrized; puncture accounting frozen. No differential Galois group, no monodromy matrix, no (mu, lambda) value, no Kovacic run.
permanent: SINGULAR_POLYNOMIAL = E - P_n, NOT P_n (E is a free parameter, not frozen to 0)

3.singular_polynomial: f_{a,E}(q) = 2(E - P_n(q; a))  [NOT P_n; equals 2(E - P_n), roots = roots of E - P_n]
3.algebraic_nve: f y'' + (f'/2) y' + (mu + lambda q) y = 0  with x = q = q1
3.finite_singular_set: the n roots of f_{a,E} (simple when disc(f) != 0)
3.base: P^1_q minus (3 finite roots of f_{a,E} + infinity)

generators: x_1: loop based at the basepoint d_0, travelling counterclockwise once around the j-th root r_j (roots ordered by the frozen ordering below)
x_2: loop based at the basepoint d_0, travelling counterclockwise once around the j-th root r_j (roots ordered by the frozen ordering below)
x_3: loop based at the basepoint d_0, travelling counterclockwise once around the j-th root r_j (roots ordered by the frozen ordering below)
x_inf: loop counterclockwise around infinity in the local coordinate 1/q
pi_1.relation: x_1 x_2 ... x_n x_inf = 1  (so x_inf = (x_1 ... x_n)^{-1} and the group is free on x_1..x_n)
pi_1.basepoint: d_0 on the boundary of a disk D containing all n finite roots; D minus the roots is the n-punctured disk D_n of BB Sec.4.4
pi_1.ordering: roots r_1..r_n ordered by the position of the corresponding puncture in D_n, matching the strand ordering 1..n of B_n; any reordering is a relabelling by an element of S_n and is recorded, not assumed
pi_1.derivation: P^1 minus infinity = C; C minus the n roots deformation-retracts onto D_n; pi_1(D_n, d_0) is free on x_1..x_n (BB Sec.4.4). Adding the puncture at infinity back as a generator x_inf introduces exactly the relation x_1...x_n x_inf = 1. LOCAL_DERIVED elementary; the free-group statement is BB Sec.4.4.
pi_1.rank_if_infinity_omitted_note: P^1 minus n points has pi_1 free of rank n-1: omitting infinity changes the rank, so infinity MUST be counted
